caption: A clear glass marble is held up in front of a lamp, and the room appears tiny and warped inside the marble.

sa.check: A clear glass marble is held up in front of a lamp.
The room appears inside the marble.
The image is tiny and warped.

pc.expect: The small distorted image is inside the marble and the room around it is normal.
pc.fail: The image is outside the marble; or the room around it is warped; or the marble is opaque.

pc.expect: The image moves as the marble moves.
pc.fail: It stays fixed while the marble moves; or it moves with the marble still; or it shows a different room.

pc.expect: The marble moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It floats; or rolls by itself; or jumps.
It bends; or melts; or ripples.
The marble duplicates; or the lamp vanishes; or the hand passes through the marble.

pc.expect: The lamp and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The lamp changes; or the room rearranges; or the marble changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
